paragraphs: He lived in the time of Shmuel’s father. Mentioned in Yevamot 115b; he was not a Torah scholar.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman explicitly says that he was not a Torah scholar.

The named William Davidson Yevamot 115b paragraph quotes Androlinai in a divorce document and Shmuel’s father sending it for examination. Hyman’s contemporaneity statement is retained; his explicit ‘not a Torah scholar’ remains his statement, rather than a conclusion independently established by that selected paragraph. The punctuation after the locator is retained in the Hebrew witness and is not treated as proof of missing text.
